There is one more raw label read in the same family. It shows in the developer console only, not to users. `action:button`'s `handleClick` calls `readStaticParamValues(schema, 'action:button')`. Its node-level-params warning prints `String(subject.name ?? subject.label ?? '(unnamed)')` (`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/static-params.ts` ~71), so a nameless action with a locale-map label prints `[object Object]` there.

When this card adds its shared guard, route that read through it too (or through PR #37262's `renderableLabel`).
